user.title: Librus APIX Integration Setup
user.description: Enter your Librus Synergia login credentials

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Librus. Please check your credentials.
error.no_access: This account has no access to the Synergia school register or messages (Librus shows 'Brak dostępu'), e.g. a preschool account.

init.title: Librus APIX Settings
init.description: Configure additional options for the integration.

data.fetch_messages_count: Number of messages to fetch from Librus (higher number slows down startup, recommended ~10, max 25)
data.fetch_messages_content: Fetch full message content (Marks them as read in Librus system!)
data.days_before_exam_study: How many days before exam to remind about studying? (0 = disabled)
data.scan_interval_school_minutes: Polling interval on school days 7:00-16:00, in minutes (default 15, fewer requests to Librus with a higher value)
data.scan_interval_minutes: Polling interval at other times and on weekends, in minutes (default 120)
data.show_not_counted_grades: Show grades not counted towards the average (e.g. improved grades), marked with "*"

ai.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Settings

data.ai_summary_enabled: Enable AI Assistant module (Summaries of grades, attendance and messages)
